type.quote: The Governor shall appoint nine persons, six of whom must be engaged in the practice or teaching of professional engineering in any of its disciplines except military engineering, and two of whom must be engaged in the practice or teaching of land surveying and one of whom must be a member of the general public.

age_minimum.quote: A person who is 21 years of age or older may apply to the Board, in accordance with the provisions of this chapter and any regulations adopted by the Board, for licensure as a professional engineer.

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant for licensure as a professional engineer must: (a) Be of good character and reputation

degree_required.value: graduate of an engineering curriculum of 4 years or more that is approved by the Board
degree_required.quote: an applicant for licensure as a professional engineer is not qualified for licensure unless the applicant is a graduate of an engineering curriculum of 4 years or more that is approved by the Board

credential_pegged.quote: a graduate of an engineering curriculum of 4 years or more that is approved by the Board

required.quote: has a record of 4 years or more of active experience in engineering which is satisfactory to the Board and which indicates that the applicant is competent to be placed in responsible charge of engineering work

experience_source.quote: has a record of 4 years or more of active experience in engineering which is satisfactory to the Board and which indicates that the applicant is competent to be placed in responsible charge of engineering work

duration.quote: has a record of 4 years or more of active experience in engineering

kind.value: active experience in engineering, including 2 years under direct supervision of a licensed professional engineer
kind.quote: Two of the 4 years of active experience must have been completed by working under the direct supervision of a professional engineer who is licensed in the discipline in which the applicant is applying for licensure

exams.name: Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)
exams.notes: May be waived by the Board if applicant has graduated from an approved engineering curriculum and has 15 years or more of experience in engineering.
exams.jurisdiction: national (administered or authorized by the Board)
exams.quote: An examination on the fundamentals of engineering that must cover the subject matter of a general education or training in engineering.

exams.name: Principles and Practices of Engineering (PE)
exams.notes: Must pass FE (or receive waiver) before taking PE exam. Covers the discipline of engineering in which the applicant is applying.
exams.jurisdiction: national (administered or authorized by the Board)
exams.quote: An examination on the principles and practices of engineering that must cover the discipline of engineering in which the applicant is applying for licensure.

interval_years.quote: The Board shall require the biennial renewal of each license of a professional engineer or professional land surveyor

renewal_fee_usd.quote: collect a fee for renewal of not more than $100, prescribed by regulation of the Board

required.quote: The Board shall adopt regulations concerning continuing education for professional engineers and professional land surveyors.

available.quote: The Board may issue a license to practice professional engineering or land surveying to an applicant, upon presentation of evidence that the applicant is licensed to practice professional engineering or land surveying, respectively, and in good standing in a state, territory, possession of the United States or country that maintains standards of engineering or land-surveying licensure, equivalent to those in this state

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed and in good standing in a state, territory, possession of the United States, or country with equivalent standards; Board may require a written or oral examination by not less than three professional engineers.
requirements.quote: The Board may issue a license to practice professional engineering or land surveying to an applicant, upon presentation of evidence that the applicant is licensed to practice professional engineering or land surveying, respectively, and in good standing in a state, territory, possession of the United States or country that maintains standards of engineering or land-surveying licensure, equivalent to those in this state, if the applicant, in the judgment of the Board, has the necessary qualifications pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

exists.quote: The Governor shall appoint nine persons, six of whom must be engaged in the practice or teaching of professional engineering in any of its disciplines except military engineering, and two of whom must be engaged in the practice or teaching of land surveying and one of whom must be a member of the general public. disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of any fraud or deceit in obtaining, attempting to obtain, or renewing a license, or cheating on any required examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of any fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain or renew a license or cheating on any examination required by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of professional engineering or land surveying.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any gross negligence, incompetency or misconduct in the practice of professional engineering as a professional engineer or in the practice of land surveying as a professional land surveyor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting any person in the violation of any provision of the chapter or regulation adopted by the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting any person in the violation of any provision of this chapter or regulation adopted by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or entry of a plea of nolo contendere to any crime involving dishonesty or directly related to the practice of engineering or land surveying.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or entry of a plea of nolo contendere to any crime an essential element of which is dishonesty or which is directly related to the practice of engineering or land surveying.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the chapter or regulation adopted by the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this chapter or regulation adopted by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another state, territory, the District of Columbia, a foreign country, the Federal Government, or any other governmental agency for substantially equivalent grounds.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another state or territory, the District of Columbia, a foreign country, the Federal Government or any other governmental agency, if at least one of the grounds for discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to any ground contained in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing after the license has expired, been suspended, or been revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing after the license of the professional engineer or professional land surveyor has expired or has been suspended or revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with an order issued by the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with an order issued by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide requested information within 30 days after receipt of a request by the Board or its investigators concerning a complaint.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide requested information within 30 days after receipt of a request by the Board or its investigators concerning a complaint made to the Board.

definition_quote.value: "The practice of professional engineering" includes, but is not limited to: (a) Any professional service which involves the application of engineering principles and data, such as surveying, consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design, or responsible supervision of construction or operation in connection with any public or private utility, structure, building, machine, equipment, process, work or project, wherein the public welfare or the safeguarding of life, health or property is concerned or involved.
definition_quote.quote: "The practice of professional engineering" includes, but is not limited to: (a) Any professional service which involves the application of engineering principles and data, such as surveying, consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design, or responsible supervision of construction or operation in connection with any public or private utility, structure, building, machine, equipment, process, work or project, wherein the public welfare or the safeguarding of life, health or property is concerned or involved.

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: The Board shall certify as an engineer intern or land surveyor intern any person qualified pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

surveyor_in_training_certificate_availab.quote: The Board shall certify as an engineer intern or land surveyor intern any person qualified pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: Graduation from a college or university in a discipline of engineering with a master's or doctoral degree is equivalent to 2 years of active experience, except that, in the aggregate, not more than 2 years of active experience may be satisfied by graduation from a college or university with such degrees, regardless of the number of degrees earned.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible charge of work" means the independent control and direction, by the use of initiative, skill and independent judgment, of the investigation or design of professional engineering or land-surveying work or the supervision of such work.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: It is unlawful for a professional engineer to sign or stamp any plans, specifications or reports that were not prepared by the professional engineer or for which he or she did not have responsible charge of the work.

seal_document_types.quote: A professional land surveyor may practice land surveying and prepare: (a) Maps, plats, reports and descriptions

firm_practice_allowed.quote: A firm, partnership, corporation or other person engaged in or offering to engage in the practice of engineering or land surveying in this state shall employ full-time at least one professional engineer or professional land surveyor, respectively
